description: This file defines classes and objects for calculating and aggregating variance impurity measures used in regression within Spark's MLlib. It includes the Variance object for calculation, VarianceAggregator for updating statistics, and VarianceCalculator for computing impurity from stored statistics.

classes.name: Variance
classes.description: Object for calculating variance impurity during regression, including methods for variance calculation and instance retrieval.

classes.name: VarianceAggregator
classes.description: Class for updating and managing sufficient statistics for variance impurity calculation across data samples.

classes.name: VarianceCalculator
classes.description: Class for storing sufficient statistics for a specific (node, feature, bin) and computing impurity.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates variance impurity given count, sum, and sum of squares of labels.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Variance object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the sufficient statistics with a new sample's label, weight, and count.

methods.name: getCalculator
methods.description: Creates a VarianceCalculator for a specific set of statistics.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the VarianceCalculator.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Provides the predicted value based on the statistics.
